errors.text: The proposed compositional gradient is not specified by element, direction, magnitude, or fabrication method, so it is not a reproducible intervention.
The mechanism conflicts with the target evidence: active diffusion and surface-energy-driven Au/Cu segregation dominate rather than generic lattice-strain reduction suppressing segregation.
No exposure duration, heating rate, atmosphere, catalyst environment, or quantitative compositional and size boundaries are provided.
Bulk-averaging XRD and unspecified EDS measurements are insufficient to resolve nanoscale surface segregation, evaporation, particle-shape evolution, or loss of 2–4 nm particles.
